name: Hats and ride
why: Driving closed hats with a ride cymbal on the offbeat. The ride is what makes a techno loop feel like it is going somewhere.

ingredients.name: Eighth-note hats
ingredients.adds: Closed hats twice a beat from the default kit.

ingredients.name: Accent the offbeat
ingredients.adds: The hat between the kicks is louder than the one on them.
ingredients.listenFor: The hats start to bounce against the kick.

ingredients.name: Ride on the offbeat
ingredients.adds: A long, washy cymbal between the kicks.
ingredients.listenFor: A shimmer that joins the beats together.

knobs.label: ride level
knobs.below: You only notice it when it stops.
knobs.above: A wash that hides the hats.

knobs.label: clap level
knobs.below: The loop feels like it has no middle.
knobs.above: It is louder than the kick.
